# Changelog

All notable changes to fERP Pro will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-19

### Added
- 🎯 **Cascading Mode** — Auto-fill all pending feedback forms sequentially
- 🎯 **Selective Mode** — Fill individual forms with granular control
- 👍 **Feedback Profiles** — Positive, Neutral, and Negative sentiment presets
- 🔀 **Option Randomization** — Natural variation in rating selection
- 🎯 **Per-Professor Profiles** — Assign different sentiments per professor
- 📊 **Progress Dashboard** — Real-time progress bar and action log
- 💾 **Profile Presets** — Save, load, export, and import configurations
- ⏱️ **Smart Delays** — Configurable human-like delays between submissions
- 🔔 **Desktop Notifications** — Alerts on completion or captcha needed
- 📝 **Custom Feedback Text** — Custom text for open-ended comment fields
- 🎨 **Dark/Light Mode** — Theme toggle with system preference detection
- 🛡️ **Dry Run Mode** — Preview fills without submitting
- 📋 **Form Status Overview** — Table of all forms with status badges
- ⌨️ **Keyboard Shortcuts** — Alt+Shift+S to start, Alt+Shift+X to stop
- 🔄 **Auto-Retry** — Automatic retry with configurable max attempts
- 📥 **Auto Admit Card Download** — Downloads admit card after all forms complete
- 🔒 **Privacy-First** — All logic runs locally, no external servers
- 🌐 **Cross-Browser** — Single codebase supporting Chrome and Firefox
